scope: Read-only independent review of formal combat feedback implementation; no runtime changes, no full regression, no ground review.

findings.condition: Resume a paused battle; next tick settles hit/kill/pickup before feedback.advance synchronizes paused.
findings.result: consume returns using previous-frame paused=true, then BattleView clears events permanently. Probe: battle.paused=false; advance(0,true); consume(hit); advance(.016,false): damage_events delta=0, marks=0, numbers=0.
findings.minimal_fix: Synchronize presenter pause state from battle.paused before consumption, or sync pause explicitly before tick/consume; add resume-first-tick event test.
findings.status: resolved; independently re-probed after owner fix

findings.condition: F05_curse/F05_spread/curse_bind initial direct hit has mechanic=curse, direct=true, secondary=false.
findings.result: Classified as periodic; no contact mark, number, sound or enemy confirm_hit for nonlethal direct hit. Probe damage_events=1 but marks=0 numbers=0 contacts[1].periodic=true.
findings.minimal_fix: Classify DOT by explicit periodic event flag or ability=curse_dot/secondary causal semantics, not mechanic=curse. Preserve direct initial curse hit.
findings.status: resolved; independently re-probed after owner fix

findings.condition: Same target has direct hit then secondary or DOT damage in one batch.
findings.result: Last event overwrites contact.periodic, suppressing primary body flash/offset. Probe direct then secondary yields contact_periodic=true.
findings.minimal_fix: Merge contacts with nonperiodic impact priority; do not replace existing nonperiodic contact with periodic.
findings.status: resolved; independently re-probed after owner fix

findings.condition: Ordinary enemy_tell is indistinguishable from major threat; every tell stops low-priority voices and resets .22s suppression.
findings.result: Synthetic 20 hit batches with ordinary tells at .1s intervals: sounds_started=0, sounds_limited=20. Real encounter frequency/subjective audibility not established.
findings.minimal_fix: Attach major/category/position to enemy_tell and limit ducking to relevant major cues or use bounded attenuation without killing every ordinary impact.
findings.status: resolved; independently re-probed after owner fix

verified_by_inspection: Player hit facts capture true HP loss and shield absorption before armor regeneration; full shield avoids red tint.
Boss bank applies encounter-budget delta once and records last effective damaging cast for later kill; no extra damage emitted on bank release.
Presenter uses local RNG and no simulation writes/time scale changes.
Hit clip never overrides tell/active/released attack clip; sprite-only displacement does not move geometry.
Elite events are provisional/requires_victory and text explicitly states victory-after reward; actual persistence remains campaign victory-only.
Combat feedback marks/numbers/voices have 32/10/6 caps; sound_casts expires after .18s, cooldown category map fixed. Failure/exit clear feedback.
residual_bounds: Existing death_views has .3s lifetime but no explicit count cap.
Existing enemy_battle_effects.seen grows by release count until battle end, no count/time prune.
No direct listening, interactive replay, screenshot audit or full regression in this review.

checks.result: exit 0; independent probes reproduced listed feedback defects
Independent PASS 232 checks; isolated /tmp XDG; no capture, no full suite
Independent rerun exit 0; all four original defect probes now show expected behavior; clean exit after explicit probe-owned node cleanup

review_result: No remaining blocking or high-priority finding in reviewed scope after fixes. Original four P2 findings resolved by owning executor and independently rechecked.

recheck.ordinary_tell_every_100ms: sounds_started=6 limited=14; no longer silenced by every tell. This tight loop uses no wall-clock wait and may saturate real voices.
recheck.source_review: consume reads current battle.paused and updates voice pause; periodic uses secondary or ability=curse_dot; contacts prefer nonperiodic; ordinary tells only duck when major is established.
